changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE product ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, sku VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT uk_product_sku UNIQUE, unit VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, width NUMERIC(38,2), height NUMERIC(38,2), depth NUMERIC(38,2), weight NUMERIC(38,2), price NUMERIC(15,2), min_stock_level NUMERIC(15,3) DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); CREATE TABLE warehouse ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, address VARCHAR(255), type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('CENTRAL', 'STORE')), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); CREATE TABLE user_coeff ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, group_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT uk_user_coeff_group UNIQUE, coefficient NUMERIC(10,4) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); CREATE TABLE delivery_time_coefficient ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, start_time TIME NOT NULL, end_time TIME NOT NULL, coefficient NUMERIC(10,4) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); CREATE TABLE outbox_event ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, event_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, json_event TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, sent_at TIMESTAMP );

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE outbox_event; DROP TABLE delivery_time_coefficient; DROP TABLE user_coeff; DROP TABLE warehouse; DROP TABLE product;

changeSet.author: daniil
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE users ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, username VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT uk_users_username UNIQUE, password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, role user_role NOT NULL, full_name VARCHAR(255), is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, warehouse_id BIGINT CONSTRAINT fk_users_warehouse REFERENCES warehouse(id), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); CREATE INDEX idx_users_warehouse ON users(warehouse_id); CREATE TABLE warehouse_location ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, warehouse_id BIGINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_location_warehouse REFERENCES warehouse(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, rack VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, shelf VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, max_width NUMERIC(10,2), max_height NUMERIC(10,2), max_depth NUMERIC(10,2), max_weight NUMERIC(10,2), is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT uq_warehouse_location UNIQUE (warehouse_id, rack, shelf) ); CREATE TABLE replenishment_request ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, warehouse_id BIGINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_replenishment_warehouse REFERENCES warehouse(id), central_warehouse_id BIGINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_replenishment_central REFERENCES warehouse(id), status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'COMPLETED')), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE replenishment_request; DROP TABLE warehouse_location; DROP TABLE users;

changeSet.author: daniil
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE stock ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, product_id BIGINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_stock_product REFERENCES product(id), warehouse_id BIGINT CONSTRAINT fk_stock_warehouse REFERENCES warehouse(id), location_id BIGINT CONSTRAINT fk_stock_location REFERENCES warehouse_location(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, quantity NUMERIC(15,3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CONSTRAINT ck_stock_quantity CHECK (quantity >= 0), updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT uq_stock_product UNIQUE (product_id) ); CREATE TABLE invoice ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, type invoice_type NOT NULL, status invoice_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT', supplier_name VARCHAR(255), from_warehouse_id BIGINT CONSTRAINT fk_invoice_from_warehouse REFERENCES warehouse(id), to_warehouse_id BIGINT CONSTRAINT fk_invoice_to_warehouse REFERENCES warehouse(id), created_by_user_id BIGINT CONSTRAINT fk_invoice_created_by REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, confirmed_by_user_id BIGINT CONSTRAINT fk_invoice_confirmed_by REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, confirmed_at TIMESTAMP, comment TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); CREATE TABLE store_request ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, warehouse BIGINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_request_warehouse REFERENCES warehouse(id), status VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'COMPLETED')), requested_by_user_id BIGINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_request_requested_by REFERENCES users(id), approved_by_user_id BIGINT CONSTRAINT fk_request_approved_by REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, comment VARCHAR(255), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE store_request; DROP TABLE invoice; DROP TABLE stock;

changeSet.author: daniil
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE invoice_item ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, invoice_id BIGINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_invoice_item_invoice REFERENCES invoice(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id BIGINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_invoice_item_product REFERENCES product(id), quantity NUMERIC(15,3) NOT NULL, quantity_need NUMERIC(15,3) NOT NULL, price NUMERIC(15,2), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); CREATE TABLE store_request_item ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, request_id BIGINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_request_item_request REFERENCES store_request(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id BIGINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_request_item_product REFERENCES product(id), requested_quantity NUMERIC(15,3) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); CREATE TABLE replenishment_request_item ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, request_id BIGINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_replenishment_item_request REFERENCES replenishment_request(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id BIGINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_replenishment_item_product REFERENCES product(id), quantity NUMERIC(15,3) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT ck_replenishment_quantity CHECK (quantity > 0), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT uq_replenishment_product UNIQUE (request_id, product_id) );

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE replenishment_request_item; DROP TABLE store_request_item; DROP TABLE invoice_item;
